sentences.en: The puppy's single good eye begs me for adoption.
sentences.zh: 那只小狗的一只眼睛可怜巴巴地望着我，希望我能收养它。

sentences.en: Same-sex adoption rights are an important issue for the LGBT* community.
sentences.zh: 同性恋群体有权收养孩子是一个重要的议题。

sentences.en: I think I'll put up my child for adoption.
sentences.zh: 我想我会把我的孩子送出去让人收养。
